{"script":"# Create or truncate matches.txt
: > matches.txt
found=no
# Use process substitution so the while loop runs in current shell
while IFS= read -r -d "" p; do
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p regular" >> matches.txt
    found=yes
  else
    echo "$p not_regular" >> matches.txt
  fi
done < <(find /working -name workspace -print0 2>/dev/null)
# Write flag file and output final answer
echo "$found" > found_regular.txt
printf "%s" "$found"
"}
